inputs.52.text: Soft painterly picture-book illustration in thick, velvety gouache: visible round brush strokes, colours laid in soft overlapping layers, edges melting gently into one another, a faint warm paper grain under the paint. One girl with shoulder-length black hair in a navy school uniform, holding a dark green umbrella tilted back over one shoulder, standing whole in a three-quarter view and looking up with a quiet, curious face. Centred on a plain, even, soft misty grey-blue painted ground with a little margin around her, even diffuse light, the girl filling most of the frame.
